text: I can pick the right Redis data structure for a feature and write the commands for it.
I can set TTLs correctly and explain how SET, KEEPTTL and lazy expiry behave.
I can compare RDB and AOF and estimate how many writes a crash loses under each.
I can explain hash slots, MOVED redirects and hash tags in Redis Cluster, and what async replication can lose.
I can explain why Redis commands are atomic and why KEYS or a long script stalls every client.
I can make multi-step logic safe with a single command, MULTI/EXEC with WATCH, or a Lua script.
